## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check-types` and `pnpm format` pass locally
- [ ] Data changes: every edited entry has a source (a link in the pull request or the entry itself)
- [ ] Code changes: tests added or updated, and the change works in light and dark mode
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `data:`, `docs:`, `chore:`…)
